title: Creases on a square sheet
description: A square sheet with a horizontal, a vertical and a diagonal crease line crossing at its centre.

title: Four angles at a crossing
description: Two crossing lines with the four angles a, b, c, d marked as 63, 117, 63 and 117 degrees.

title: A linear pair makes 180
description: Two crossing lines with the upper angles of 120 and 60 degrees highlighted and a bracket marking 180 degrees.

title: Why facing angles are equal
description: Two crossing lines with angle a in purple, angles b and d in teal, and the equations a + b = 180, a + d = 180 and b = d.

title: Four right angles
description: Two tilted lines crossing with a square mark and the number 90 degrees in each of the four angles.

title: Meet at an end, or intersect
description: Left, two segments share the endpoint F with 115.3 degrees between them; right, two segments cross at the point X.

title: Parallel lines after each fold
description: Three squares folded once, twice and three times with 3, 5 and 9 parallel lines.

title: A fold parallel to a diagonal
description: A square sheet with a diagonal, a dashed second diagonal and an amber crease parallel to the first diagonal.

title: A transversal and eight angles
description: A line t crossing lines l and m with eight numbered angles in four colour-matched opposite pairs.

title: Same corner, other crossing
description: Angles 1 and 5 filled in the top left corner of each crossing, joined by a dashed arrow.

title: Copy the angle, get parallel
description: Lines l and m crossed by t, with the matching 60° angles a and b marked and arrow marks showing parallel.

title: Parallel lines, equal corners
description: Parallel lines l and m crossed by a transversal, with matching corners coloured and labelled 65° or 115°.

title: Slide the set square
description: A set square at two positions along a ruler with two vertical lines each making 90° with line l.

title: Two moves to the alternate angle
description: Parallel lines with angles f, b and d each 120°, joined by arrows labelled Move 1 and Move 2.

topic_name: Interior Angles on the Same Side
title: Inside, same side adds to 180
description: Parallel lines with the interior angles 3 = 50° and 6 = 130° on the same side of the transversal.

title: Straight and parallel after all
description: Left, two lines look bent among spokes; right, a ruler and three equal gaps show they are straight and parallel.
